page_title: LEC 1-0 GEN | Lecce v Genoa 22/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A player from Genoa commits a rough challenge. Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. It's a free kick to Lecce, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90+5' 4:3 – the corner kicks stats.
90+3' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) fires in an effort from the free kick from some 18 metres. His strike is very inaccurate and ends in row Z.
90+2' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and George Puscas (Genoa) comes onto the pitch so that Albert Gudmundsson can be given a rest.
89' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) replaces Stefano Sabelli.
87' Substitution. Alexis Blin (Lecce) replaces Nikola Krstovic.

83' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Remi Oudin (Lecce) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Josep Martinez just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
83' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game. One of the players from Lecce won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Genoa earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
81' A player from Lecce commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
79' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Gabriel Strefezza is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
79' The substitution has been made. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) has replaced Mohamed Kaba.
79' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Valentin Gendrey (Lecce). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
78' Lecce keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
76' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Milan Badelj will be replaced by Silvan Hefti (Genoa).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes onto the pitch for Mateo Retegui.
75' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
75' Remi Oudin (Lecce) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.
73' Ahmed Touba (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Rapuano saw the whole situation. Genoa are awarded the free kick.
70' The opposition can't get near Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
68' Lecce take a short corner kick.
68' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Lecce earn a corner.
67' The number of offsides is – 1:0.

65' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Josep Martinez, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
64' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
62' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
60' It will be a substitution. Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) is ready to enter the pitch as Antonino Gallo walks off.
60' Here is a change. Hamza Rafia is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Remi Oudin (Lecce).
59' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Rapuano ignores the protests.
58' Milan Badelj (Genoa) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
58' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
57' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Good work from Lecce as they win a corner.
56' The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
55' Ahmed Touba (Lecce) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
53' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game. One of the players from Genoa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick to Lecce.
49' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and signals a foul after Marin Pongracic (Lecce) brought his opponent down. Genoa win a free kick.
48' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
46' Alberto Gilardino has made a change at the break. Johan Vasquez (Genoa) has come on in place of Koni De Winter.
46' The whistle blows and Antonio Rapuano starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' 6:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
36' Aaron Martin (Genoa) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
35' A player from Genoa commits a rough challenge. Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Lecce are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
33' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
28' The referee blows his whistle as Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) was too aggressive in his challenge.
25' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play. Genoa win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
24' A player from Lecce commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
23' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.

20' The game is interrupted. Mateo Retegui (Genoa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Lecce win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
19' Lecce concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
16' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
15' The ball possession is 57:43.
10' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
9' Antonio Rapuano shows the yellow card to Aaron Martin (Genoa) for a heavy challenge.
7' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Koni De Winter (Genoa) is given a yellow card.
7' Koni De Winter (Genoa) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
7' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game. One of the players from Lecce won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
5' One of the players from Lecce times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
5' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce). Lecce have a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
